goal: Move the Device Passport from database-first presentation to answer-first presentation without changing the evidence model or SEO URL surface.

p0_public_sync: Confirm Phase143 is deployed on the canonical Japanese Device Passport.
Synchronize stale static Device Passport counts on the passport and primary entry surfaces.
p1_answer_first: Show SIM/eSIM, mobile data, voice, SMS, tethering, 5G, Dual SIM and evidence summary immediately after exact-model selection.
Keep unknown states explicitly unverified instead of inferring compatibility.
Keep detailed bands, carrier fit, evidence matrices and source URLs below the summary.
Add direct actions to focused SIM/eSIM, communication and Dual SIM diagnostics.

evidence_rules: Answer First does not create new compatibility claims.
A capability specification is not treated as runtime confirmation.
SolQvia real-device evidence remains separate from official and third-party evidence.
Existing per-function evidence matrix remains the authoritative detailed evidence view.
qa_targets: JA/EN Device Passport each load Phase144 CSS and JavaScript once.
JA/EN Device Passport static search count starts at 572 instead of 550.
Home and device-compatibility primary Device Passport promos show 572 records.
